format.format: Vertical 9:16 pixel-art 3D mechanism explainer, music bed only (no voice), every idea on a title placard; a speed HUD at the top

style.render_style: Toon-shaded 3D rendered at about 190 pixels across and scaled up (chunky pixels, stair-stepped edges), with crisp 2D HUD and callouts on top
style.outline: Thin dark rim outline (one art pixel) on model edges; HUD plates have dark ink borders
style.shading: Cel bands: base, a darker shadow band and a light top-left band per surface, with checker-dithered transitions; translucent shells as a pale outline with low-opacity fill
style.shape_language: Chunky rounded machine parts (cylinders, blocks, rods, teeth) at exaggerated close-up scale; the HUD is a row of badge, semicircle dial and digit counter over a wide placard
style.texture: Dithering in shadows; huge out-of-focus shapes of the surroundings behind the parts; thin concentric vibration rings
style.type_ui: Placard: cream plate, dark ink border, striped end caps, headline in a heavy slab serif dark ink, subline bold sans in red; step number in a red circle badge on its top-left corner; speed badge (red REAL SPEED, blue NNx SLOWER, x2 FASTER flash) top-left; semicircle dial top centre; label plus 4 digit cells counter top-right; callouts: small cream tag, dark caps text, thin leader line ending in a small square on the part; a big red pop word on each action
style.motion_style: Never still: the mechanism always runs at the current slowdown; each speed step flashes the badge and swings the dial needle; parts move with motion-blur smears at higher speeds
style.signature: The speed HUD: time slowed 256x and doubled back to real speed step by step while the counter shows the real rate divided by the slowdown; a numbered walk down the chain of parts, each answering what drives the last; x-ray pull-back; loops to the first frame
style.do_not_copy: The @engineeredwithin1 watermark; the topic (the hand device, the shop, the head, the blades, the specific numbers and words)

story.summary: Asks how an everyday fast device works, slows time 256x to show the working end, then walks part by part down the chain to the power source, each step answering what drives the previous one, then speeds back up to real speed with the whole device in x-ray and loops.
